A_KEEP.path: server.js, index.html, app.js, styles/**, public/**, protected visual sources and rollback contracts
A_KEEP.currentUse: Protected static rollback runtime, legacy hashes, assets, visual contracts, and owner evidence.
A_KEEP.benefit: Preserves exact rollback and owner-authorized visual recovery.
A_KEEP.risk: Archiving or deletion would violate the owner contract and remove rollback coverage.
requiredTests: All current runtime, recovery, visual, and static rollback gates.

B_REFACTOR_LATER.currentUse: Active lint, CI, and release/build-gate tooling.
B_REFACTOR_LATER.benefit: A future supported upstream migration would clear the security gate without weakening lint coverage.
B_REFACTOR_LATER.risk: Current supported alternatives are incomplete or peer-invalid; no change is authorized now.
requiredTests: Full Prompt 23A-S security and Gate C regression scope after a supported release exists.
B_REFACTOR_LATER.rollback: Revert only a future focused dependency-remediation commit.

D_DELETE_AFTER_STABILIZATION_AND_EXPLICI.currentUse: Six-byte apply-patch diagnostic probe containing only 'probe'; no parsed import, require, path, runtime, rollback, test, CI, build, documentation, visual, or owner dependency.
D_DELETE_AFTER_STABILIZATION_AND_EXPLICI.archiveRejectedReason: Archiving a six-byte diagnostic probe would add more permanent navigation and evidence overhead than it preserves.
D_DELETE_AFTER_STABILIZATION_AND_EXPLICI.benefit: 6 tracked bytes and one root navigation entry; no bundle, build, or test-time effect; Git-history reduction 0.
D_DELETE_AFTER_STABILIZATION_AND_EXPLICI.risk: Low functional risk based on complete static/reference proof, but deletion remains gated by future candidate-level owner approval and all action prerequisites.
requiredTests: clean Gate C/security state or separately approved future action-phase exception

F_BLOCKED_UNKNOWN.risk: No candidate-specific existing safe cleanup command was verified, and cleanup is outside Prompt 23A-I.
